witch.name: witch
witch.ref_text: Guten Abend. Ich sehe die Linien deiner Hand klar vor mir.
witch.speaker_description: A very calm, very slow middle-aged female German voice with a natural Asian accent and subtle Korean cadence. Low-pitched, warm, mature, soft, steady, and quietly mysterious. She speaks with long pauses, restrained emotion, stable pitch, and gentle, deliberate pacing.
